body: CI macos-latest / node 26 on 5bfbe66: "rolls back and drops a client that idles inside a transaction" timed out at 5000 ms. The test sets txnIdleMs to 100; on a loaded runner the socket is destroyed before the reply to the insert arrives, and the test waits for that reply for ever. Test only.

completion.summary: Test only. The idle-transaction test waited for the reply to its insert with no limit; with a 100 ms idle timer a loaded runner could destroy the socket first, and the test hung to its 5 s limit (CI macos-latest / node 26 on 5bfbe66). It now waits for the reply or the close, and the timer is 300 ms. Passed 3 runs alone and the full gate.

title: Flaky daemon test: idle-transaction timer can fire before the call is answered
